description: This file defines the 'SugarWidgetFieldId' class, which extends 'SugarWidgetReportField', and includes a method 'queryFilterIs' used for filtering report queries based on ID fields. It is part of the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM codebase, specifically related to widget handling of ID fields in reports.

classes.name: SugarWidgetFieldId
classes.description: A widget class used for handling ID fields in SugarCRM report views.

methods.name: queryFilterIs
methods.description: Constructs a filter query for 'is' condition using the ID field, quoting the input value properly.
